verdict.rationale: Granola docs confirm a documented REST API for programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries (granola-docs-1,16,33,34), and reference both individual and workspace-level API keys, implying self-serve key generation (granola-docs-28). However, action items are not explicitly called out as a retrievable field, and a probe found no live OpenAPI/swagger spec, suggesting the API reference may be thin or beta (granola-probe-2). missing for 10: explicit documentation of action-item extraction, a public OpenAPI/schema reference, and independent developer corroboration of successful API key self-service and querying.
